eyebrow.zh: 开发工具 · 本地示例

headline.zh:
配置不只留在聊天里，
也跟着文件走。
headline.en:
Keep the deployment context.
Carry it with the file.

sub.zh: ggufbill 读取 GGUF 元数据与整文件摘要，把操作者填写的运行参数、硬件条件和部署说明保存为 JSON 旁挂清单。
sub.en: ggufbill reads GGUF metadata and a whole-file digest, then saves operator-supplied runtime settings, hardware requirements and deployment notes in a JSON sidecar.

caption.zh: 让模型文件带上部署说明
caption.en: Keep deployment notes beside the model file.

body.zh: 整文件 SHA-256 与元数据进入同一清单。
body.en: Whole-file SHA-256 and metadata appear in the same manifest.

body.zh: context、KV 类型和 engine build 由操作者明确填写。
body.en: Operators explicitly record context, KV type and engine build.

body.zh: JSON 便于检查、版本管理与外部工具读取。
body.en: JSON supports inspection, version control and external readers.

title.zh: 让模型文件带上部署说明
title.en: Keep deployment notes beside the model file.

body.zh: 只保留模型文件，往往会丢掉当时使用的上下文长度、KV 类型和 engine build。把这些字段放在相邻清单中，交接和复查时就有明确记录。清单记录的是输入与声明，不会自动证明某个部署能运行或符合审计要求。
body.en: Keeping only the model file can lose the context length, KV type and engine build used with it. A neighboring manifest makes those settings available for handover and review. The manifest records inputs and declarations; it does not prove a deployment runs or satisfies an audit requirement.

body.zh: 脚本使用仓库的 318 字节 metadata-only GGUF，写出临时清单并回读字段。结果确认完整文件 SHA-256 一致、context_length=4096、kv=f16、operator=demo-operator。Qwen3-27B 是该构造文件的元数据名称，并非加载了 27B 权重。
body.en: The script uses the repository’s 318-byte metadata-only GGUF, emits a temporary manifest and reads its fields. It confirms a matching whole-file SHA-256, context_length=4096, kv=f16 and operator=demo-operator. Qwen3-27B is the fixture’s metadata name; no 27B weights are loaded.

body.zh: GGUF reader 提取名称、架构、量化和参数元数据并计算 SHA-256；emit 收集运行/硬件/操作者字段；manifest.Validate 检查必需值后写 JSON。inspect、audit 和 llama-server 调用合成目前都是后续里程碑接口。
body.en: The GGUF reader extracts identity, architecture, quantization and parameter metadata and computes SHA-256. emit collects runtime, hardware and operator fields; manifest.Validate checks required values before JSON is written. inspect, audit and llama-server command synthesis are later-milestone interfaces.

body.zh: ggufbill 读取 GGUF 元数据与整文件摘要，把操作者填写的运行参数、硬件条件和部署说明保存为 JSON 旁挂清单。
body.en: ggufbill reads GGUF metadata and a whole-file digest, then saves operator-supplied runtime settings, hardware requirements and deployment notes in a JSON sidecar.

body.zh: 当前只实现 emit；inspect、audit 和执行命令合成尚未实现。
body.en: Only emit is implemented; inspect, audit and execution-command synthesis are not.

note.zh: 真实 emit 和 JSON 回读（演示录制于 v0.1.0，v0.2.0 的命令与输出保持一致）。硬件、工具调用可靠性和监管符合性均未测试，临时文件结束后清理。
note.en: Real emit and JSON readback (recorded on v0.1.0; the commands and output are unchanged in v0.2.0). Hardware, tool-calling reliability and regulatory compliance are not tested; temporary files are removed afterward.

body.zh: 脚本使用仓库的 318 字节 metadata-only GGUF，写出临时清单并回读字段。结果确认完整文件 SHA-256 一致、context_length=4096、kv=f16、operator=demo-operator。Qwen3-27B 是该构造文件的元数据名称，并非加载了 27B 权重。
body.en: The script uses the repository’s 318-byte metadata-only GGUF, emits a temporary manifest and reads its fields. It confirms a matching whole-file SHA-256, context_length=4096, kv=f16 and operator=demo-operator. Qwen3-27B is the fixture’s metadata name; no 27B weights are loaded.

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+；完整自清理示例使用 Python 3。首次构建可能下载 Go 模块，示例不下载模型。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+ and Python 3 for the self-cleaning demo. Initial builds may download Go modules; the example downloads no model.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/ggufbill.git
cd ggufbill
go build -o ggufbill ./cmd/ggufbill

limitations.zh: 当前只实现 emit；inspect、audit 和执行命令合成尚未实现。
limitations.en: Only emit is implemented; inspect, audit and execution-command synthesis are not.

limitations.zh: 清单字段不证明硬件适配、推理成功、工具可靠性或合规。
limitations.en: Manifest fields do not prove hardware suitability, successful inference, tool reliability or compliance.
